exam: 2024年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: It may sound surprising, but you don't have to be interested…

sents.en: It may sound surprising, but you don't have to be interested in fashion, or even in history, to enjoy Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History.
sents.cn: 这听起来或许出人意料，但即便你既不热衷时尚、也不爱好历史，也能享受《着装密码：时尚法则如何造就历史》一书。

sents.en: I happen to be interested in both, and ended up enjoying the book for completely different reasons.
sents.cn: 我恰好两者都感兴趣，到头来却因全然不同的缘由而喜欢上了这本书。

sents.en: Richard Thompson Ford is a law professor, and you probably won't forget that for even one page.
sents.cn: 理查德∙汤普森∙福特是一位法学教授，你大概连一页都忘不了这一点。

sents.en: His carefully reasoned arguments, packed with examples, sound almost like reading a court opinion, only maybe wordier.
sents.cn: 他论证缜密、例证丰富，读来几乎像在看一份法庭意见书，只是或许更啰嗦些。

sents.en: You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again.
sents.cn: 此后，你大概再也不会把时尚视作无足轻重的小事了。

sents.en: Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them.
sents.cn: 福特的核心论点是：要理解特定时尚在某一时代意味着什么，最佳方式是审视施加于其上的限制。

sents.en: Through this lens, he shows us that the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions.
sents.cn: 透过这一视角，他指出，13世纪颁布的首批法律——规定只有贵族才能穿着特定面料、颜色与饰物——折射出中产阶级的崛起，他们如今已能模仿其中某些时尚。

sents.en: The status of the upper classes was threatened: fashion was a tool to preserve it.
sents.cn: 上层阶级的地位受到威胁：时尚便是维系这一地位的工具。

sents.en: Ford takes the reader through the evolution of fashion while examining the underlying motivations of status: sex, power, and personality, which, he assumes, influenced all innovations in fashion in the past and which continue to influence us today.
sents.cn: 福特带着读者纵览时尚的演变，同时审视地位背后的动机：性、权力与个性——他认为这些动机过去影响了时尚的一切创新，至今仍在影响我们。

sents.en: His writing is more than a little dense · dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns.
sents.cn: 他的文字颇为艰深——充斥着考据、从句，以及精准的形容词与名词。

sents.en: But there's also humor and enough interesting episodes to make the writing appealing.
sents.cn: 但其中也不乏幽默，以及足够多的有趣轶事，令文字引人入胜。

sents.en: No one is spared his sharp analysis: not the easy targets of 19th century women's crippling (伤害身体的) fashions nor the modern uniforms of Silicon Valley T-shirts.
sents.cn: 没有任何人能逃过他犀利的分析：无论是19世纪残害女性身体的时尚这些显而易见的靶子，还是硅谷T恤这类现代制服。

sents.en: But the greatest strength of this book (on fashion!) is its intellectual profoundness.
sents.cn: 不过，这本（关于时尚的！）书最大的长处在于其思想深度。

sents.en: Ford asks us to question unconscious beliefs, to realize that we almost never do so, to understand that the simplest choices are charged with meaning, and yet that meaning can and does change all the time.
sents.cn: 福特要求我们去质疑那些无意识的信念，意识到我们几乎从不这样做，去理解最简单的选择也饱含意义，而那意义能够而且确实在时刻改变。

sents.en: Consider the fact that a 1918 catalog insisted that boys and girls be dressed in the appropriate color.
sents.cn: 想想这一事实：1918年的一本商品目录坚持男孩女孩须穿着“应属”的颜色。

sents.en: We believe our thinking today is evolved.
sents.cn: 我们以为自己今天的思维已经进化。
福特向我们证明：并没有。
